meta.title: 普通人和爱豆之间原来只差一个表情管理
meta.title_en: The Only Difference Between You and an Idol Is Expression Control
meta.topic: 表情管理 · 上镜技巧

scenes.title_cn: 微笑：说 money 代替茄子
scenes.context: 普通人一拍照就表情僵硬、眼神乱飘。真正有用的上镜管理是系统工程。微笑最简单的方法是放弃说茄子，说英文单词 money，舌头自然抵住上颚，微笑弧度完美，还能拉长下颌线、让双下巴消失。语域：美妆博主分享，口语化教学。
sentences: 有的女生私下很生动很漂亮，可是一拍照就表情僵硬。
Some girls are lively and pretty in person, but freeze up the moment the camera comes out.
freeze up（表情僵硬）
真正有用的上镜管理，其实是一套系统工程。
The expression control that actually works is a systematic approach.
systematic approach（系统工程）
放弃说茄子，学会说一个英文单词 money。
Drop 'cheese' and learn to say one English word: money.
drop 'cheese'（放弃说茄子）
paraphrase: 表情僵硬 → freeze up / stiffen up
系统工程 → systematic approach / a whole system
scenes.speak: Some girls are lively and pretty in person, but freeze up the moment the camera comes out. The expression control that actually works is a systematic approach. Drop 'cheese' and learn to say one English word: money.

scenes.context: 第二个关键点就是眼神，艺人必修课，专业说法叫焦点虚化。错误示范是直勾勾盯着镜头，会很僵硬很凶。自拍时看向发际线位置；别人拍时看向镜头偏下一两厘米处，想象后面站着你最喜欢的人，眼神就有延伸和对话感。语域：教学示范，先错后对。
sentences: 直勾勾地盯着镜头，眼神就会很僵硬，看起来还很凶。
Staring straight into the lens makes your eyes look stiff and even fierce.
stare straight into the lens（直勾勾盯着镜头）
自拍的话，就看向发际线的位置。
For selfies, look toward your hairline instead.
look toward your hairline（看向发际线）
想象后面站着你最喜欢的人，眼神就会有延伸。
Imagine your favorite person standing behind the lens, and your gaze will carry.
your gaze will carry（眼神有延伸）
paraphrase: 眼神僵硬 → stiff eyes / lifeless gaze
眼神延伸 → your gaze carries / soft focus
scenes.speak: Staring straight into the lens makes your eyes look stiff and even fierce. For selfies, look toward your hairline instead. Imagine your favorite person standing behind the lens, and your gaze will carry.

scenes.context: 有时不是表情不对，而是皮肤有点松，一笑肉就乱堆。这是面部皮肤的紧致度和弹性跟不上表情的灵活度，就像在沙地上盖楼容易垮。博主分享自己定期做抗衰射频项目（舒立提）维持面部紧致度。语域：美妆护肤分享，夹带种草。
sentences: 有时候拍照不是表情不对，而是皮肤有点松了。
Sometimes it's not your expression — your skin is a bit loose.
skin is loose（皮肤松了）
就像在沙地上盖楼，很容易垮掉。
It's like building on sand — it easily collapses.
building on sand（沙地盖楼）
皮肤贴骨，线条干净，怎么拍都好看。
When skin hugs the bone with clean lines, every shot looks good.
hugs the bone（贴骨）；clean lines（线条干净）
paraphrase: 皮肤松了 → skin is loose / skin has lost firmness
皮肤贴骨 → skin hugs the bone / firm and defined
hugs the bone · firm and defined
scenes.speak: Sometimes it's not your expression — your skin is a bit loose. It's like building on sand — it easily collapses. When skin hugs the bone with clean lines, every shot looks good.

scenes.title_cn: 呼吸：呼气做表情，吸气定住
scenes.title_en: Breath: Exhale Into the Expression, Inhale to Hold It
scenes.context: 最后一个表情管理大法是呼吸法。呼气时做表情，吸气时将表情定住。比如回眸一笑：转身看镜头时先呼气微笑，然后顶住呼吸把pose维持在那里，表情又灵又自然，整个人状态也是提着的。真正的上镜美不是硬凹出来的。语域：教学收尾，总结升华。
sentences: 呼气时做表情，吸气的时候将表情定住。
Make the expression as you exhale, and freeze it as you inhale.
freeze it as you inhale（吸气定住）
先呼气微笑，然后顶住呼吸，把pose维持在那里。
Exhale into a smile, then hold your breath and hold the pose.
hold the pose（维持pose）
真正的上镜美，不是硬凹出来的。
Real on-camera beauty isn't forced into existence.
isn't forced（不是硬凹出来的）
paraphrase: 定住表情 → freeze the expression / hold it
硬凹 → force it / fake it
scenes.speak: Make the expression as you exhale, and freeze it as you inhale. Exhale into a smile, then hold your breath and hold the pose. Real on-camera beauty isn't forced into existence.

practice: Drop 'cheese' and learn to say one English word: money.
For selfies, look toward your hairline instead.
Make the expression as you exhale, and freeze it as you inhale.
Real on-camera beauty isn't forced into existence.
pitfalls: She freezes when taking a photo.
She freezes up the moment the camera comes out.
「表情僵硬」用 freeze up / stiffen up。
Look at the camera is fierce.
Staring straight into the lens makes your eyes look fierce.
「直勾勾盯」用 stare straight into the lens。
My skin is a little fluffy.
My skin is a bit loose — it has lost firmness.
「皮肤松」用 loose / lost firmness，不是 fluffy。
Real beauty is not made by force.
Real on-camera beauty isn't forced into existence.
shifts: 用 say money（舌头抵上颚）、dropped cheese（放弃茄子）
用 stare straight（直勾勾）、look toward your hairline（看发际线）、gaze carries（眼神延伸）
用 skin firmness（皮肤紧致）、hugs the bone（贴骨）、hold the pose（维持）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：摆世不爽→说 cheese、石矿→表情、抗摔→抗衰、明灵机→法令纹、卖充→探头、下颌线、焦点虚化、发际线、硬凹、回眸一笑等。
